tests.stimulus: All requests low, ack low, saveBGBlock=0; first span 2 effective reset edges.; Change the active-low reset between edges to confirm that state is not cleared immediately, then cross an edge; perform operations after legally writing the cache/colors respectively, and observe Z on the undriven FIFO outputs.
tests.expected: Synchronous control reset; do not assume unreset storage is cleared to 0, and do not check its data values before legal establishment.
tests.checker: Predict independently from protocol state and input history; compare actual/expected using four-state comparison in legal valid windows; report errors for X/Z valid data, and require both undriven FIFO outputs to be Z. Actual sampling windows for this test: Bus outputs are combinational functions of the current state/inputs and may be sampled before the edge after the inputs have been stable for 1ns; sequential state updates on the gpuClk edge.

tests.stimulus: Apply synchronous reset and clear all requests, with ack low.; Assert the four request classes individually and simultaneously; with idle ack high/low, compare the first-beat address, cnt, and direction; hold the command, then clear it.
tests.expected: Use independent priority and byte-alignment calculations; do not assume BG write priority or FIFO queuing based on source-code comments.
tests.checker: Predict independently from protocol state and input history; compare actual/expected using four-state comparison in legal valid windows; report errors for X/Z valid data, and require both undriven FIFO outputs to be Z. Actual sampling windows for this test: Request selection is a pre-edge combinational value, and the active transaction is latched on the rising edge; subsequent cnt defaults to 0.

tests.stimulus: A transaction has been selected on the first beat with ack low, and an edge has been crossed to enter the active state.; Hold ack high for 1/2/8/9 consecutive beats, changing dat_i every beat, then cross an edge with ack low; verify early termination and index wraparound.
tests.expected: Count and terminate according to the input ack history; do not construct expectations from DUT req feedback.
tests.checker: Predict independently from protocol state and input history; compare actual/expected using four-state comparison in legal valid windows; report errors for X/Z valid data, and require both undriven FIFO outputs to be Z. Actual sampling windows for this test: First stabilize ack during the low phase, check the current beat address before the edge, and check the advanced outputs after the edge; cnt has length meaning only on the first beat.

tests.stimulus: Idle with ack low and other requests cleared.; Issue command 1 separately at each mask/pair boundary, and issue fill command 2; change command colors during activity and observe each beat with ack high.
tests.expected: Decode colors/masks/byte addresses independently; write data must equal the latched fields.
tests.checker: Predict independently from protocol state and input history; compare actual/expected using four-state comparison in legal valid windows; report errors for X/Z valid data, and require both undriven FIFO outputs to be Z. Actual sampling windows for this test: Colors and masks are latched on the initiation edge, and wrt=1 when active with ack high; the first beat still uses the default read direction.

tests.stimulus: Clear other requests; after the first beat, hold the address requests until activity ends.; Test L/R/both requests separately, hold ack high for 2 beats with different data on each, then provide a third value on the low termination beat; check completion and writeback in their respective windows.
tests.expected: Independently record the initiating side and beat 0; concatenate the current high half with the first-beat low half for termination data.
tests.checker: Predict independently from protocol state and input history; compare actual/expected using four-state comparison in legal valid windows; report errors for X/Z valid data, and require both undriven FIFO outputs to be Z. Actual sampling windows for this test: The completion side and TexCacheWrite have different windows; the high half of the data follows dat_i directly and is sampled after 1ns in the termination cycle.

tests.stimulus: With no higher-priority requests, issue CLUT while idle with ack low.; Provide 8 distinct dat_i values, sample separately before and after edges, and confirm the pipeline-tail write flag after termination; test early termination after 1 beat.
tests.expected: Use an independent beat and one-beat write-index pipeline, with data passing directly from the current input.
tests.checker: Predict independently from protocol state and input history; compare actual/expected using four-state comparison in legal valid windows; report errors for X/Z valid data, and require both undriven FIFO outputs to be Z. Actual sampling windows for this test: Check pre-edge address/completion separately from post-edge write flag/index; the data itself has no corresponding register.

tests.stimulus: First hold saveBGBlock at 0 across an edge; establish usable data through a complete 8-beat background read.; Test all block/blending combinations separately, checking write masks and active addresses, write termination, and the subsequent read phase; after completion, hold nonzero, then return to 0 to retrigger.
tests.expected: Use independent edge history, a block queue, and an 8-word array; do not backfill from actual imported values.
tests.checker: Predict independently from protocol state and input history; compare actual/expected using four-state comparison in legal valid windows; report errors for X/Z valid data, and require both undriven FIFO outputs to be Z. Actual sampling windows for this test: The first beat sets busy, and the final termination edge clears busy; the background cache is valid only after a legal read history, and source-side save/load/export remain stable until completion.

tests.stimulus: Apply synchronous reset; first perform an 8-beat read command 3 for each bank.; Load both banks word by word with different dat_i values, test mask patterns and clear-other separately, then observe using subsequent command 4.
tests.expected: Use independent arrays of 16 halfwords for each of the two banks and pixel masks; the read cache itself has no public direct port and is verified through writeback.
tests.checker: Predict independently from protocol state and input history; compare actual/expected using four-state comparison in legal valid windows; report errors for X/Z valid data, and require both undriven FIFO outputs to be Z. Actual sampling windows for this test: The read-bank cache is written through a pipeline of active beats and their indices; use the writeback command only after termination.

tests.stimulus: Both banks have been fully read with legal, distinct data, and both masks have been established.; Iterate over VVIndex, bank, and force/check, with stencil alternating and all 0/1; after clearing a bank at termination, issue writeback again to observe mask clearing.
tests.expected: Use an independent circular array of 32 16-bit pixels, assembling words using arithmetic indices; use independent Boolean operations for mask and stencil.
tests.checker: Predict independently from protocol state and input history; compare actual/expected using four-state comparison in legal valid windows; report errors for X/Z valid data, and require both undriven FIFO outputs to be Z. Actual sampling windows for this test: bank, rotation, stencil, force/check, and bank-clear controls are latched on the first beat; observe each active beat with ack high.
